notes.text: Apply eebf8bb8 first. Under the live 25694c88 this packet would boot without 'pdm1trackpadenum=1': the T1 adapter's probe declines, no PDM1TrackpadEnumerationV1 exists, the collector fails (not 0/77) and the supervisor exits 1, so the run fails closed but proves nothing. Require before-start bootargs ending 'pdm1kbd=1 pdm1trackpadenum=1'.

Even ENUMERATION_CAPTURED proves only that real interface-2 metadata and descriptor bytes were received over the read path. Descriptor HID validity, feature report 0x02, MT mode, a child device and pointer input all stay later work, as the criteria's not_claimed list says.
I wrote the adapter. Producer safety still needs Astra's independent source review before boot, as criterion T1 requires.
